meta_desc_schedule: A summary of the reorganization plan schedule, including briefings, opinion exchanges, and planned implementation dates.
news_note: 🔄 Fetched automatically every day from the city website. Headlines are machine-translated; the linked pages are in Japanese.
notice: ⚠️ This is an unofficial community site and is not the official Komaki City website. For official information, please visit the Komaki City Board of Education.
phase1_body: Held the "Think About Schools" meetings (5 sessions in total), reported to community councils and neighborhood association heads. Shared the current situation in Shinooka district (rapid decline in student numbers, aging facilities) with local residents.
phase2_body: Conducted student surveys (online), parent surveys (online), Shiroyama 3&4-chome briefings, parent opinion exchange meetings (3 sessions), and a community briefing. Also conducted the new school name survey.
phase3_body: Held public comment on the draft reorganization plan. A total of 142 submissions from 55 people were received (submitters: 39 by email, 13 by fax, 1 by post, 2 in person). The city published responses and a revised plan.
phase4_body: Held the School District Advisory Committee on January 13, 2026. The 5th "Think About Schools" meeting was held on February 7 at the East Community Center.
phase5_body: Official decision on the reorganization plan, formulation of school bus plan, establishment of preparation committees for new schools, etc. Please check the official announcements from Komaki City Board of Education for details.
phase6_body: The 4-school system of Tokadai Higashi Elementary, Tokadai Nishi Elementary, Tokadai Higashi JHS, and Tokadai Nishi JHS will launch. School bus service for elementary students (fully funded by the city — free) will also begin.
phase7_body: If student numbers fall further after Phase 1, the city is considering merging the schools into 1 elementary and 1 junior high school and introducing integrated elementary-junior high education. Whether and when this happens will be judged in light of how Phase 1 goes; it has not been decided (About Phase 2).
phase7_date: Timing not decided (to be judged after Phase 1)
pr_tk_h: Tokadai wo Kangaeru Kai is looking for new members
pr_tk_note: A notice from a citizens’ group. This is not a city recruitment. (In Japanese)
pr_tk_p: A citizens’ group that holds music festivals, lectures and seminars on housing and vacant homes. You are welcome just to observe its regular meeting on Saturday 12 December from 10:00 (planned venue: East Community Center). You can also speak to the staff at the 11th Tokadai Music Festival on Sunday 15 November.

sched_desc1:
1st "Think About Shinooka District Schools" meeting (East Community Center Hall, capacity 300)
Topic: Issues surrounding school education in Shinooka district
sched_desc10: 1st Parent Opinion Exchange Meeting (East Community Center)
sched_desc11: 2nd & 3rd Parent Opinion Exchange Meetings (East Community Center)
sched_desc15:
Public Comment Period
142 submissions from 55 people received (submitters: 39 by email, 13 by fax, 1 by post, 2 in person). City published responses and revised plan.
sched_desc18: School District Advisory Committee (Komaki City Hall East Building)
sched_desc19:
5th "Think About Shinooka District Schools" meeting (East Community Center Hall)
Topic: Draft reorganization plan for Shinooka district
sched_desc2:
2nd "Think About Shinooka District Schools" meeting (East Community Center Hall)
Topic: Review of 1st meeting, draft reorganization plan for Shinooka district
sched_desc20:
Plan Finalization & Implementation Preparation (in progress)
Establishment of preparation committees for Shinooka Gakuen's 4 schools, formulation of school bus plan, etc. For the latest information, check the official city page.
sched_desc21:
Shinooka Gakuen School Emblem Design Contest
Design a shared emblem for all 4 schools. Open to: Komaki city residents/students/workers, or those with school experience in Shinooka district. Prizes: ¥20,000 (1st) and ¥5,000 (runners-up) in Komaki Premium vouchers. Submit via web or paper form.
sched_desc22:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (Toryo JHS Gymnasium)
For: Parents of Toryo JHS district (including preschool children entering FY2027). No pre-registration needed. Approx. 2 hours. 28 people attended.
sched_desc23:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (Shinooka JHS Gymnasium)
For: Parents of Shinooka JHS district (including preschool children entering FY2027). No pre-registration needed. 73 people attended.
sched_desc24:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (Sue Elementary Gymnasium)
For: Parents of Sue Elementary district (including preschool children entering FY2027). No pre-registration needed. 66 people attended.
sched_desc25:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (Oshiro Elementary Gymnasium)
For: Parents of Oshiro Elementary district (including preschool children entering FY2027). No pre-registration needed. 104 people attended.
sched_desc26:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (Hikarigaoka JHS Gymnasium)
For: Parents of Hikarigaoka JHS district (including preschool children entering FY2027). No pre-registration needed. 67 people attended.
sched_desc27:
Parent/Guardian Briefing (East Community Center Hall)
For: All school district parents and local residents (covering both Tokadai Higashi & Nishi schools). No pre-registration needed. Approx. 2 hours. Limited parking — public transport encouraged. 45 people attended.
sched_desc28:
Phase 1 Reorganization — Launch (Planned)
Shinooka Gakuen (Tokadai Higashi Elem, Tokadai Nishi Elem, Tokadai Higashi JHS, Tokadai Nishi JHS) 4-school system starts. School bus service for elementary students begins (fully funded by city — free).
sched_desc28__after:
Phase 1 Reorganization — Carried Out
Shinooka Gakuen (Tokadai Higashi Elem, Tokadai Nishi Elem, Tokadai Higashi JHS, Tokadai Nishi JHS) began as a four-school system. School bus service for elementary students also started (fully funded by the city — free).
sched_desc29:
Briefing Session Q&A and Responses Published
Records of Q&A from each venue, along with responses to questions submitted via opinion sheets, have been published on the city's official website.
sched_desc3:
3rd "Think About Shinooka District Schools" meeting (East Community Center Hall)
Topic: Review of 2nd meeting, school districts & school buses, future direction
sched_desc30:
Joint exchange event of the five elementary schools (grades 4–5)
4th and 5th graders of the five Shinooka elementary schools met by year group at the East Community Center. After a short dance, time was set aside for everyone to mix.
sched_desc31:
School bus application period
The application form and a briefing invitation were sent to guardians of children inside the service area. The form had to be returned whether or not a seat was wanted, and applications closed on 30 September. The city has said that the stops, the timetable and the “School Bus Use Guidelines” are to be handed out and explained at the briefing for applicants, together with a consultation session. See the school bus page for details.
sched_desc32:
Joint exchange event of the five elementary schools (all years)
Following July’s event for grades 4–5, a joint event for every grade is planned. Exchanges between particular schools and year groups are also to continue on a planned basis.
sched_desc33:
Contract signed with the school bus operator
Seven firms were invited; Aoi Kotsu Co., Ltd. won with ¥111,750,000 (excl. tax). The contract runs 8 June 2026 – 31 March 2030 and covers Komaki City. See the school bus page.
sched_desc34:
Pre-entry health check (2027 intake)
Held at the five current elementary schools.
sched_desc35:
School bus trial rides and app testing
Children ride the actual buses to check the routes, the stops and how easy boarding is. The app used to confirm boarding is to be trialed in the same period.
sched_desc36:
Joint school management council of the eight schools
The eight schools being reorganized are to hold a joint management council.
sched_desc37:
Enrolment briefing and pre-commute trial
The briefing is held at the two new elementary and two new junior high schools. A “pre-commute” exercise helps children get used to the journey.
sched_desc38:
Closing ceremonies (five elementary, three junior high) and moving of equipment
Each of the eight current schools holds a closing ceremony, and equipment is moved to the new schools.
sched_desc39:
“Arigato Oshiro-sho” (resident-run)
At Oshiro Elementary School, which is closing, a festival market in the gym and baseball on the ground are planned, with food trucks. Committee members and volunteers were also being recruited (check the organizers’ Instagram for the latest). This is organized by residents, not by the city or the school. See community efforts.
sched_desc4:
4th "Think About Shinooka District Schools" meeting (East Community Center Hall)
Topic: Review of 3rd meeting, parent opinion exchange & community briefing results, review of draft reorganization plan
sched_desc40:
New School District Music Festival (community council)
In the gym of Hikarigaoka Junior High School, an event to widen ties across the new school district through music and dance. Applications to perform closed on 30 August 2026. This is run by the music section of the Hikarigaoka elementary school district community council, not by the city. See community efforts.
sched_desc41:
The “Shinooka Gakuen” emblem was decided
A single emblem for the four schools was chosen from 212 entries. The three ideals are drawn as a mathematical trefoil knot which, with a circle, forms a peach; an “S” sits at the center, with a book and wings below. It will now be displayed at the schools and made into the school flag.
sched_desc42:
TOKADAI DANCE FESTIVAL (resident-run)
A dance battle competition with a U15 division and an OPEN division, at Peare Plaza on the 2nd floor of Peare Tokadai. Watching is free. This is run by i-Support Co., Ltd., not by the city. See community efforts.
sched_desc43:
Bamboo Installation in Okusa (resident-run)
An environmental art show of bamboo works set out in the rice paddies on both banks of the Hatta River in Okusa (its 33rd year). On Sat 14 November, 10:00–15:00, the “Bamboo Art Marché & Music Fest” is also held in the Okusa Community Hall parking lot (cancelled if it rains). This is run by the Bamboo Installation Executive Committee, not by the city. See community efforts.
sched_desc44:
11th Tokadai Music Festival (resident-run)
From 14:00 (doors 13:00) in the auditorium of the East Community Center, with a program of well-known pieces played by the Chubu Philharmonic string quartet. Admission 500 yen (free for high-school students and younger). Run by 桃花台を考える会, a citizens’ group, as a joint proposal project with the city’s Eastern District Development Office. See community efforts.
sched_desc45:
Shinooka Refreshing Walk (community council)
A walking event from 10:00 to 12:00 to promote health and build connections. No registration needed; free to join. This is run by the Shinooka Elementary School district community council, not by the city. See community council events.
